summary: Backend-only security verification of the 6 CRITICAL fixes (C-1..C-6) on Trexio (node server.js on :8001 via preview /api). Created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 20 tests — all 20 PASSED. Verified: backdoor master passwords removed (401 for all 4 passwords x 2 super-admin emails, no requires_2fa/token leak), env-seeded admin password accepted (200 + requires_2fa + temp_token, no access_token cookie issued pre-2FA, same for superadmin@trexio.id), traveler login returns valid JWT, /api/auth/me works with valid Bearer and returns 401 for forged token (cookie-less request), simulate-paid returns 404 with valid token and 401 without, Midtrans webhook rejects missing signature (503 gateway-not-configured) and bogus signature (503/403) without marking anything paid, AI endpoints return 401 without token and 200 with traveler token (/assistant/chat, /orchestrate, /safety/readiness), and public GET /api/trips returns 200 with trips. Also code-reviewed server.js JWT_SECRET fail-fast, SEED_ADMIN_* env handling, verifyMidtransNotificationSignature and webhook handler — implementations match the claimed fixes.

minor.issue: Wrong-password path returns 401 in the main branch, but a separate branch (2FA-disable flow, server.js ~3082) returns 400 'Kata sandi tidak sesuai' — inconsistent status codes for credential failure (informational, not a security hole).

Auth accepts cookie-based session in addition to Bearer token; a requests.Session that logged in earlier stays authenticated even when an invalid Authorization header is sent. Expected for cookie auth, but note it for future tests (use cookie-free requests to assert token rejection).

critical_code_review_comments: server.js is ~14k lines in a single file — split into route modules; maintenance/regression risk is high for a security-sensitive codebase.
SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD non-production fallback auto-generates a random password and logs it to stdout; acceptable for dev but ensure NODE_ENV=production is enforced in deploy so fail-fast triggers.

Login unconditionally promotes any account whose email is in superAdminEmails to super_admin before password check (server.js ~2841); harmless today (2FA gate + bcrypt), but privilege assignment before authentication is a fragile pattern.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded accounts (admin@trexio.id, superadmin@trexio.id, traveler@trexio.id). Webhook tests used non-existent order ids TRX-TEST-1/TRX-TEST-2 and were rejected before any state change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. All 6 CRITICAL security fixes verified as working. NOTE: GEMINI_API_KEY appears to be configured now — AI chat/orchestrate/safety return 200 with a real answer, not 500. MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY is unset so the webhook returns 503 for any notification; if a server key is later configured, retest that a bogus signature yields 403. ALLOW_PAYMENT_SIMULATION is unset so simulate-paid returns 404. When asserting token rejection, always use a cookie-free requests call (session cookies from login otherwise authenticate the request).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found. One initial test failure (auth/me returning 200 with a forged token) was a test artifact: the shared requests.Session retained the access_token cookie from the traveler login and the server supports cookie auth. Fixed the test to issue a cookie-free request; endpoint correctly returns 401.
